title: Collection visibility
hint: Visibility controls anonymous viewing only. It does not change how people join.
public: Visible to anyone with the link
publicDisclosure: Anyone with the link can view the collection and averages from revealed rounds, but cannot participate. This does not list it in search or discovery or reveal members’ identities or individual ratings. Admission, members and invitations do not change.
privateDisclosure: The public link will stop working for anonymous visitors. You cannot erase what someone has already seen. Admission, members and invitations do not change.
unknown: The save could not be confirmed. Check the current visibility before trying again.
unverified: Current visibility could not be checked. No new change was sent.
verified: The current visibility matches your choice.
different: The current visibility differs from your choice. Check the setting above before saving again.
busy: Wait for the visibility update to finish.
